name: code-quality
description: Code-quality rules for coding agents, with measures: file size and naming, directory and package structure, dependency direction, function size, interfaces and abstraction, tests next to the tested file, duplication, and the behavior rules for a change (scope, errors, tests, dependencies, security, proof before 'done'). Two skills: rules (before you write code) and self-check (measure and review before you say done).
